items.exampleEn: After the disappearance of the old market, the street became quiet.
items.exampleZh: 老市場消失之後，這條街變得很冷清。

items.exampleEn: Scientists today know much more about the plague than people did long ago.
items.exampleZh: 今天的科學家對瘟疫的了解比古人多得多。

items.exampleEn: Quick thinking by the pilot helped avoid a catastrophe.
items.exampleZh: 機長臨機應變，避免了一場大災難。

items.exampleEn: Losing our biggest client was a serious setback.
items.exampleZh: 失去最大的客戶是一次嚴重的挫折。

items.exampleEn: I had a sense of doom when I saw the exam questions.
items.exampleZh: 一看到考題，我就有種大難臨頭的感覺。

items.exampleEn: Losing all the data would be catastrophic for a small company.
items.exampleZh: 弄丟所有資料，對小公司來說會是災難性的。

items.exampleEn: Wearing a helmet is a simple preventive measure for cyclists.
items.exampleZh: 對騎單車的人來說，戴安全帽是簡單的預防措施。

items.exampleEn: Without a catalyst, this reaction would take many hours.
items.exampleZh: 沒有催化劑的話，這個反應要花好幾個小時。
items.glossZh: 催化劑；促成改變的人或事

items.sentenceEn: The museum has a special show about the plague in the Middle Ages.
items.sentenceZh: 博物館有一場關於中世紀瘟疫的特展。

items.audioEn: The heavy rain was a setback, but the builders still finished the bridge on time.
items.audioZh: 大雨是個阻礙，但工人們還是準時完成了那座橋。
items.questionZh: 大雨對工程有什麼影響？
options: The builders never finished the bridge in the end
Work slowed, but the bridge was done on time
The builders stopped working for a whole month
The rain did not change the builders' plans at all

items.sentenceEn: Forgetting my passport at home would be a catastrophe.
items.sentenceZh: 要是把護照忘在家裡，那就慘了。

items.sentenceEn: The police are looking into the disappearance of a famous painting.
items.sentenceZh: 警方正在調查一幅名畫失蹤的事。

items.stemEn: To avoid fires, the company put ____ rules in place, such as no cooking in the office.
items.stemZh: 為了避免火災，公司訂了預防性的規定，例如辦公室裡不准煮東西。

items.stemEn: The new coffee machine became the ____ for a friendlier office; people started chatting more.
items.stemZh: 新咖啡機成了辦公室氣氛變友善的催化劑；大家開始多聊天了。

items.passageEn: For many years, the old harbor town was full of tourists. Then a series of setbacks hit: a new highway took visitors elsewhere, and a catastrophic storm damaged the main bridge. Local newspapers were full of talk of doom, and one writer said empty shops were spreading like a plague along the main street. But the disappearance of tourists became a catalyst for new ideas. Young people opened small cafes and art shops, and the town took preventive steps, such as repairing old buildings before they fell apart. Within five years, the number of visitors had risen dramatically.
items.passageZh: 多年來，這個老港口小鎮總是擠滿遊客。後來接連遇到挫折：一條新公路把遊客帶往別處，一場極嚴重的暴風雨又毀損了主要的橋。地方報紙上滿是悲觀的末日言論，有位作者說，空店面像瘟疫一樣在主街上蔓延。不過，遊客的消失反而成了新點子的催化劑。年輕人開了小咖啡店和藝術商店，小鎮也採取預防措施，例如在老建築倒塌之前先整修。不到五年，遊客人數就大幅增加了。

questions.questionZh: 遊客一開始為什麼變少了？
options: 新公路把遊客帶往別處
鎮上的物價和房租變得太高

questions.questionZh: 遊客減少後，小鎮出現了什麼變化？
options: 年輕人開了咖啡店和藝術商店
鎮上的居民全都搬到大城市去了
主街上新蓋了好幾座大型的工廠

items.promptZh: 這次挫折並沒有阻止我們再試一次。
referenceEn: This setback did not stop us from trying again.
The setback has not stopped us from trying again.
rubricZh: setback 是名詞，表示「挫折、阻礙」（例如 this setback、a serious setback）
「阻止我們…」可寫 stop us from＋V-ing 等；過去式或現在完成式都可以

items.promptZh: 那部電影促成了這座小鎮觀光業的成長。
referenceEn: That film was the catalyst for the growth of tourism in the small town.
The movie became a catalyst for tourism growth in the small town.
rubricZh: catalyst 指「促成改變的人或事」，常用 the catalyst for…、a catalyst for… 等
「觀光業的成長」可寫，例如 the growth of tourism、tourism growth 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
